payload.name: Expand recommendation queries beyond attribute terms
payload.description: When a question asks what item a person suggested or recommended (possibly with descriptive attributes), use this to retrieve memories with recommendation phrasing and avoid over-anchoring on the attributes.
content: If a question asks what a person suggested, recommended, or endorsed as fitting some description (e.g., 'awesome open-world game for the Nintendo Switch'), do not build all searches around the descriptive terms; the supporting memory may state the recommendation without those terms.

Run an additional memory search using the person's name together with suggestion verbs such as 'recommends', 'suggested', 'suggests', 'advises', and if known the general category of the item (e.g., 'game', 'book'), even if the attribute terms are absent.

Before answering, prefer a memory that explicitly records a recommendation or suggestion over one that merely matches the descriptive attributes; if none of the retrieved memories explicitly state a suggestion, keep searching before answering.

solves: When a question asks what specific item (game, book, movie, etc.) a person suggested or recommended and includes descriptive attributes, retrieval often over-anchors on the attribute words and misses memories that state the recommendation using verbs like 'recommends' without those attributes. This skill instructs the agent to run additional searches with suggestion verbs and to prefer explicit recommendation evidence over attribute-matching but non-recommendation memories, covering any future question about a person's suggested items.
